post.description: Compute today's full Lung Wellness Score from the latest symptom check-in (and audio scores when available), store it in history, and advance the personal baseline. Returns the score, component breakdown (C/B/S/T), baseline status, and a user-facing message. Call this after a check-in/recording session.

Finalize the current screening session: advances the session counter and updates the personal trend baseline ONCE. Call this after the user has completed their check-in AND both recordings for the day — not after each step. This is what makes 'symptoms + cough + breathing' count as ONE session, not three.

get.description: Full Lung Wellness Score history for the user, newest first. Each record has the final score, component sub-scores, session number, baseline status, and timestamp. Use limit/offset for pagination. This is the data to plot the wellness trend chart.
The single most recent Lung Wellness Score for the user (or null if none yet). Use for the home-screen score dial.

The user's baseline lifecycle status: session count, status (initializing/active/stale/expired), and the user-facing message (e.g. 'Complete 3 more sessions to activate your trend score'). Use to show baseline-progress UI.

Symptom component score S only (0-100, higher=better) for a date (default today; pass on=YYYY-MM-DD). May return score null with band 'critical' when the seek-care override fires — show the message, not a number.
Score band legend (ranges, labels, messages) so the app renders the score legend from the backend — thresholds can change without an app release.

Unified activity history — cough recordings, breathing recordings, and symptom check-ins merged into one list, newest first. Each entry has: type, activity_id, timestamp, status, and results. Filter with ?type=cough|breathing|symptom. Paginate with limit/offset. User-scoped — only the caller's own records.
Cough recording history only — previous cough recordings and their analysis, newest first.
Breathing recording history only — previous breathing recordings and their analysis, newest first.
Symptom check-in history only — previously submitted symptom logs with their computed scores, newest first.

GET response. Deliberately does NOT inherit the Upsert input bounds:
anything already stored in the DB must always serialize back out, even if
an older/edge value sits outside the input range. Re-applying input
constraints on output caused a 500 when a stored value was out of range.
